query: If I do not intend to renew my licence, do I need to settle my outstanding MediSave payable?
reference_answer: You’re required to pay your outstanding MediSave payable even if you do not intend to renew your licence.
answer: If you don't plan to renew your licence, you are still required to settle your MediSave payable as it's a requirement regardless of renewal intentions. [Document N] doesn't provide specific information.
